stories.title: Turkish comedian Deniz Goktas rearrested after court orders his release
stories.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Goktas rearrested after court orders his release A Turkish comedian has been rearrested after a court ordered his release in a separate case in which he was accused of insulting Islam and President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Turkish media reported. Deniz Goktas, 32, whose stand-up performances have attracted millions of views online, was detained at Istanbul airport in July. A court on Friday ordered his release following an appeal against his July detention, the private NTV broadcaster reported.  But before the ruling could be implemented, prosecutors launched a separate investigation into Goktas, who is being held in the northwestern town of Corlu.
